summary.text: John Boyd is the Utah Forward Party candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 53, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against incumbent Republican Kay Christofferson and Democrat Kevin Slater.
Boyd is a business founder who served in the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve.

paragraphs.text: Boyd served in the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve from 1986 to 1991 and earned a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University in 1993.
His career experience includes working as a business founder.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Boyd described himself as an independent-minded Forward Party candidate for District 53 who wants to reduce two-party polarization and bring back respectful policy dialogue.
He listed the following as his key messages: that more options are needed beyond the two-party system, that he would promote fact-based policy, and that he would work to fortify checks and balances.
Boyd said he is passionate about elections, immigration, rule of law, checks and balances, and constitutional law.
